summary: The exact candidate fixes vocabulary-dependent simulated token ID 100 and enforces a strict token-space bound even for oversized decode events. It does not fully resolve the original byte-completeness contract: forced recovery can finalize an incomplete UTF-8 prefix and permanently corrupt a character completed by the next event.

tests.what_was_measured: Original failure reproduced: 1,024- and 131,072-token invalid-byte streams retained equally large live decode windows with no emitted or committed text. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-94b50c1d11a1/base-repro.log
Candidate regression and neighboring stop-trimming suite passed: 15 passed. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-94b50c1d11a1/candidate-regression.log

Oversized invalid streams ended with a zero-token live window, but a 64-token stalled event ending in byte E4 followed by B8 AD produced replacement characters instead of 中. boundary_text_equal=false. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-94b50c1d11a1/candidate-adversarial.log

On gfx950, source imported from the checkout, fixture safe token ID 64 was resolved, and the synchronized ROCm tensor path produced [64, 64, 64, 64]. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-94b50c1d11a1/candidate-gpu.log

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, reported by rocminfo as gfx950 and by Torch capability (9, 5), executed the focused candidate tensor path with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. No model-serving or distributed workload was run.
remaining_counterexamples: At the 64-token recovery threshold, an event ending in the incomplete UTF-8 prefix E4 is force-committed as U+FFFD; a following event containing B8 AD can no longer complete U+4E2D, so candidate output differs from decoding the complete token sequence.
Complete U+FFFD output is still classified by the character heuristic as stalled and may be delayed until the 64-token threshold rather than being recognized immediately as complete text.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights and its exact tokenizer were unavailable, so its semantics were not directly verified.
The reported eight-GPU TP/DP/EAGLE serving workload, throughput, TTFT, and distributed routing were not reproduced.
The single-gfx950 deterministic fixture qualifies focused Python and tensor behavior only; it does not qualify a different model architecture.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json declares native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
